name: Julian Jackson
office: City of Santa Fe Springs, Member of the City Council

items.text: Julian Jackson is a vector control technician running for Santa Fe Springs City Council. His campaign says he previously worked for the city's Community Services and Parks and Recreation Department and earned a master's degree in public administration from California State University, Long Beach.

sentences.text: Julian Jackson is a vector control technician running for Santa Fe Springs City Council.

His campaign says he previously worked for the city's Community Services and Parks and Recreation Department and earned a master's degree in public administration from California State University, Long Beach.

items.text: His campaign website lists priorities including expanding youth programming, redeveloping subsidized childcare, and investing in essential businesses near residential areas. He also proposes a rent stabilization initiative, a ban on data center construction, more green spaces, increased tree canopy coverage and renewable community projects.
